item.title: Google Cloud Revenue Doubles to $30.7B as TPU Sales and AI Capex Surge
item.description:
Google Cloud revenue surged 103% year-over-year to $30.7B, driven by robust demand for AI infrastructure, with operating income tripling. The Gemini app surpassed 1 billion users, and model API throughput quadrupled, while TPU chip sales expanded to external partners like Oracle and OpenAI. Despite this growth, massive capital expenditure on AI data centers resulted in a free cash flow deficit exceeding $9B.

原文标题：谷歌云营收翻倍至 307 亿美元，TPU 外销与 AI 基建投入成焦点

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 算力从内部消耗转向外部商业化（TPU 外销）的关键拐点，以及头部厂商在巨额资本支出下的财务真实状况。

item.title: Microsoft Shares Rise 4% as Azure Revenue Grows 48%
item.description:
Microsoft shares rose about 4% in after-hours trading as Azure revenue grew 48% year-on-year to $33.2B, beating analyst forecasts. Despite data center spending falling short of internal targets due to construction delays and a 27% drop in free cash flow, contracted future revenue reached $677B. To manage rising AI infrastructure costs, Microsoft is offering buyouts to up to 60,000 employees across the US, Canada, UK, and India.

原文标题：微软 Azure 营收增 48% 股价涨 4% 拟裁员控本

Why it matters：Azure 强劲增长验证了 AI 云需求，但巨额资本支出与大规模裁员揭示了行业在盈利压力下的结构性调整。

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Carbon for Cybersecurity and Long-Horizon Tasks
item.description:
Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon, ranking first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0. The model focuses on enhanced cybersecurity capabilities (vulnerability discovery/patching) and long-horizon agentic workflows, while significantly reducing over-execution rates and resisting prompt injection attacks. It is currently available via a restricted pilot program for security defenders.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，主打网络安全与长程任务

Why it matters：新旗舰模型发布，具备明确的基准测试数据、具体的垂直领域（网络安全）突破以及独特的定价策略，对开发者与安全从业者具有直接参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: Anthropic Launches Enterprise AI Spend Analytics to Boost Retention
item.description:
Anthropic released a new suite of enterprise reporting tools designed to help customers quantify the business value of their token spend. By combining internal analytics with employee surveys, the tools provide detailed views on workflow costs, outputs, and bottlenecks, with data excluded from model training by default. This move aims to solidify Anthropic's position in the high-growth enterprise coding market by increasing data insights and switching costs.

原文标题：Anthropic 推企业级 AI 支出分析工具以增强客户粘性

item.title: Oracle Targets $30B+ Free Cash Flow by Fiscal 2029
item.description:
Oracle outlined its AI infrastructure ROI path at Investor Day, projecting positive cash flow in H2 FY2028 and at least $30B in free cash flow for FY2029. The company plans to mitigate upfront costs via customer prepayments, BYO hardware, and vendor financing, while capping future fundraising at $20B to address market concerns over massive capex. Shares surged up to 9.6% following the announcement.

原文标题：Oracle 目标 FY2029 自由现金流超 300 亿美元

Why it matters：明确了 Oracle 在 AI 数据中心巨额投入后的财务回本时间表与融资策略，直接回应了市场对算力基建可持续性的核心疑虑。

item.title: DeepMind Proposes CALLIOPE for Privacy-Safe Topic Modeling
item.description:

Why it matters：解决了隐私计算中主题聚类质量差的痛点，提供了明确的工程权衡方案（精度 vs 成本）。
